inspections.finding: The full lamed ends in a tapered diagonal above a distinct wide horizontal lower mark. The mark has a compact bar contour and no descending stem, lower third point, vertical pair, or paired-lobe boundary. Literal lamed patah in לעשות and לצדיקים has the same horizontal shape. The lamed qamats in למו has a definite downward stem; lamed sheva in לבער has two vertically separated dots; lamed segol in יכלת has an upper pair and lower node; plain lamed in שאול has no added lower shape. These source pixels distinguish the target bar. Propose U+05B7 after baseline lamed at unit scalar offset20, retaining all original scalars and order.

The entire qof shows its retained interior dagesh, diagonal bowl, independent descending leg, and a short level lower bar. White space separates the bar from the diagonal bowl; the bar meets the descending leg at its left end and extends horizontally to the right. It has no downward stem beneath its outer bar. Literal horizontal patah controls in לעשות and לצדיקים establish the bar shape; the qof hiriq in לצדיקים is a small single round dot, the qof segol in וקרח has a lower multi-node extension, and plain qof in ותברק has no added bar. The target's level bar remains distinct from its consonant leg and defeats those competitors. Propose U+05B7 after the existing qof+dagesh cluster at baseline unit scalar offset22. Preserve the existing U+05E7,U+05BC order and append the new vowel rather than normalize it.

Below the complete pe bowl, the target has a lower transverse arm projecting to the left of a distinct downward stem. That stem descends substantially below the arm and the letter's ordinary lower edge. The same-page pe in רפאם supplies a literal qamats with that head-and-stem construction; the lamed qamats in למו supplies a second clear shape control. Pe segol in נפש instead has an upper paired/triangular cluster and lower node; pe tsere in ירדפם has lateral lower dots; plain pe in נרדפו ends at the bowl with no lower arm-and-stem. The target's complete contour certifies qamats, not a mere thickened pe foot or a dot group. Propose U+05B8 after baseline pe at unit scalar offset100. The earlier coarse PDF pixels did not establish this mark; the approved Psik screenshots are the primary evidence.
